fields.name: clamp_and_free_height

fields.name: experiment_label_evidence
fields.figure_finding: Fig.8 digitized: all four labels agree with the nearest plotted marker within 10 rpm and 0.028 mm. Fig.9 spectra show only w_t peaks at stable points and w_c peaks at unstable points. Fig.10 shows rough surface at B and D.

fields.impact: labels are usable as a directional check; not external physical validation

fields.name: marker_population
fields.figure_finding: Fig.8 contains 13 labelled experimental points while Section 6.3 describes only four. A whole 4000 rpm group (0.162 stable, 0.403 stable, 0.623 unstable, 0.811 unstable) is never mentioned in the text.
fields.impact: the anchor carries three times more labelled data than the text reports; usable as a directional dataset if the free-height gap is accepted

contradictions.text: there is only the tool tooth passing frequency (i.e., 200 Hz, 400 Hz, 600 Hz, 650 Hz, 666 Hz, 833 Hz, 875 Hz, and 917 Hz.)
contradictions.r1_claim: text is self-contradictory; 1500 rpm should give a 50 Hz tooth-passing base that is missing
contradictions.r2_correction: The list mixes higher harmonics while Fig.9 annotates only the two dominant peaks per point. 600=12x50 and 650=13x50 for A, 833=10x83.3 for C, 900=9x100 for D all check out. The r1 wording was too strong and is withdrawn.
contradictions.remaining_defect: Four numbers in the text list (200, 400, 666, 917) appear nowhere in Fig.9, and 666 Hz is not an integer multiple of either 50 Hz or 83.3 Hz, so the list is not citable. Separately, C's 875 Hz is annotated as w_t but equals 21x41.67 Hz (spindle frequency), not an integer multiple of the 83.3 Hz tooth-passing rate.

anomalies.problem: radial coefficient twice the tangential one is unusual for Ti-6Al-4V (typical Kr/Kt about 0.2-0.5)
possible_causes: different force projection convention in Eq.(60)
typographical error in the published values
anomalies.required_action: do not substitute into mechanics.py before Eq.(60) sign convention is resolved

anomalies.observation: Table 2 stiffness, Table 2 frequency and Table 1 geometry cannot be reconciled by a single cantilever single-DOF model

checks.result: L=80 mm gives 366.9 Hz versus reported 575 Hz (57% low); L=63.9 mm would be needed to hit 575 Hz
L=29.0 mm, whose f1 would be 2783 Hz, a factor 5 away from 575 Hz

checks.path: interpret k as modal stiffness omega^2*m
checks.result: m=91.2 g (mode 1) and 100.2 g (mode 2), while the whole plate weighs 44.2 g and a cantilever mode-1 modal mass is about 0.24x total = 10.6 g; modal mass exceeding total mass is not physical

anomalies.conclusion: no self-consistent explanation yields 80x40x3 mm, 1.19e6 N/m and 575 Hz at once; adding a free height as a free parameter would fix the frequency but void the stiffness column
candidate_causes: the Stiffness column includes fixture interface stiffness
575 Hz is not the whole-plate cantilever first bending mode
anomalies.required_action: check supplementary material or third-party restatement for the definition of Stiffness; if absent, the anchor is unusable at the parameter level and O1 becomes mandatory rather than optional
